messages:
Marta (SRE): incident-bot just opened INC-3402 — multi-region health/failover monitor triggered. Noting rapid traffic shift: ~65% of requests moved to us-east1 over the last 6m and error-rate for serving-proxy/us-east1 spiked to 8%. PagerDuty Bot: Paging Jordan (oncall). InfraBot: auto-created channel #inc-3402 and tagged eng-sre.
Jordan (oncall): on it. quick status: are we seeing increased latency or actual 5xx errors? any customers impacted yet? @Priya can you paste the top-level graphs?
Priya (Monitoring): latency up about 120ms median in us-east1; tail latency and 5xxs are the bigger issue — 502/504s mainly from proxy -> runtime handshake. customer-facing errors ~0.7% of requests to hosted API, some timeouts from streaming endpoints. adding dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/boards/rr/341
Alex (Infra): rolling host-level metrics now. I see a noisy NLB health check flapping in us-east1 causing backend churn. Connection resets on a subset of nodes. Might be a networking fabric hiccup. Starting a controlled drain on two nodes to see if error rate drops.
Diego (runtime): runtime logs show KV cache misses spike and gRPC stalls on the same hosts. Might be cache pressure + gRPC retry storms. I'm going to reduce batch size on that pool as immediate mitigation.
Jordan (oncall): plan: 1) remove two flapping nodes from rotation (Alex) 2) temporarily increase autoscaler headroom in us-east1 to absorb traffic (Alex) 3) reduce batch size / lower concurrency on problematic runtime pool (Diego) 4) update failover monitor thresholds to avoid noisy paging (Priya). I'll take ownership and will hand off after stabilizing.
Alex (Infra): done: drained node-us-e-12 and node-us-e-13. Autoscaler min replicas bumped +30% in us-east1 (manual override). Observability: connection resets dropped immediately on those subnets.
Diego (runtime): reduced max concurrency from 32 -> 16 for pool runtime-us-east1-hot. Tail latency down ~40ms; 5xxs dropping. patch applied: ```
# runtime config override
pools:
  runtime-us-east1-hot:
    max_concurrency: 16
    batch_window_ms: 12
```
Marta (SRE): good progress. customer-impact check: Support reported 4 tickets tied to stream timeouts in the last 20m, nothing yet marked P1. I'll notify CS that we've mitigations and to hold off on escalation unless new reports come in.
Priya (Monitoring): on alerts: the failover/health monitor was firing on a per-host error threshold (>=3 hosts >5% 5xx). That rule is too sensitive for rapid traffic shifts; it's causing noise. Propose we change to a region-aggregated rule and add a traffic-shift detector so we only page when errors are sustained >5m AND error-rate relative to baseline increases >150%.
Jordan (oncall): agree. Also want a short-term mute on the current monitor to stop duplicate pages while we stabilize. Priya, can you make the change and create a follow-up ticket to re-evaluate thresholds after postmortem?
Priya (Monitoring): will do. Muted current alert for 30m. Creating MON-872 to: 1) convert per-host rule -> region aggregate, 2) add baseline-relative threshold, 3) add a rolling 5m window and require sustained signal. Snippet of the new alert proto: ```
alert: failover_region_error_rate
expr: (sum(rate(serving_proxy_5xx_total{region="us-east1"}[5m]))
       / sum(rate(serving_proxy_requests_total{region="us-east1"}[5m])))
       > 0.05 and ( ( /baseline ) > 1.5 )
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Marta (SRE): also request adding a synthetic traffic-based failover monitor: if traffic shifts >40% within 5m and a region's success_rate drops below 97% for 5m then page. That will reduce pages for pure traffic-shift noise.
Alex (Infra): created a lightweight multi-region preemptive alarm that watches traffic % by region and cross-checks success_rate. Test alert fired in staging, working as expected. Putting that in MON-873.
Diego (runtime): long-term: we should add per-pool KV-cache metrics to make cache-pressure related stalls more visible. I'm filing RUNTIME-191 to expose kv_cache_evictions and hot-partition skews.
Jordan (oncall): handoff note: I'll remain in channel for another 30m, then pass to Marta for the post-incident work if stable. Current impact: reduced to <0.2% customer-facing errors, tail latency trending down. Next steps: Priya to land alert changes, Alex to keep autoscaler override for 1h then revert to reactive policy, Diego to monitor runtime pool and propose quantized scaling plan.
Priya (Monitoring): alert changes pushed to staging, will roll to prod in 15m and monitor for false-negatives. Also creating a new dashboard tile: "Regional Health & Failover" with these three boxes: region traffic %, region error%, cross-region shift alert. Assigned to me + UX handoff to Alex.
Marta (SRE): please note follow-ups: INC-3402 -> MON-872 (alert tuning) -> MON-873 (traffic-shift monitor) -> RUNTIME-191 (kv metrics). Schedule postmortem tomorrow 10:00am PT. Jordan, leave a short summary in the incident doc about what we changed and why.
Jordan (oncall): done. summary posted to INC-3402. Leaving handoff to Marta. tagging @Support to keep CS loop closed. :thumbsup:
Marta (SRE): thanks team. post-incident action items: - Verify mute windows and ensure no missed P1s - Do an alert-threshold review (Priya + SRE) - Add synthetic failover tests to CI (Infra + Runtime) - Dashboard finalization (Priya + Alex) We'll run a small drill next week to validate the new rules.
InfraBot: Channel #inc-3402 will be archived after 7 days of inactivity.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-3402 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned responders: Jordan (lead), Marta (postmortem).
